title: TIE Advanced x1 (Darth Vader, Star Wars)
intro: The TIE Advanced x1 is the fictional personal fighter of Darth Vader in A New Hope. In the film Vader flies from the same cockpit set as the TIE fighter, and his targeting display locks on during the trench run. The Databank adds a hyperdrive and shields that normal TIE fighters lack. The shooting model has no rear window, but the cockpit set does.
